deduplication: Unicode NFKC; collapse whitespace; strip; casefold; retain lowest original row index per label/hash
overlap_policy: exclude normalized exact matches to Combined-v2 or any of the three sealed external corpora
transformer_seed_restriction: Restricted to the original external inference verifier's authorized frozen grid; seeds 137 and 3407 are not used in this Meric2 analysis.
tfidf_source: Combined-v2-only M4 Condition-A recipe; selected C values imported from completed Task 2 inner-OOF tuning
length_matching: Exact integer word-count matching: within each word count retain min(HUMAN,AI) per class by ascending normalized text SHA-256; pair same-rank retained records only as bootstrap blocks, not as source-lineage pairs
interpretation: Post-hoc exploratory external stress test; no Meric2 model fitting, tuning, calibration, threshold selection, or causal claims
